descSpecific: Civic actions picked for {name}, with who to tell when something goes wrong
descGeneric: Simple things you can do as a citizen to help {name} grow
intro: This is your district. Government alone cannot fix everything. As citizens we have real power, and real responsibility. Small actions by many people add up to big change. Here is what you can do today.
emergency: Helpline numbers and portal links come from official government pages. Please check them before you rely on them. If a life is in danger, always dial <emergency>112</emergency> (India's single emergency number) or <ambulance>108</ambulance> (ambulance).

simpleContact: For {n} of them, we also tell you who to report to.
pictogramContact: About {n} of every 10 actions come with someone you can report to.
